Its completed internal review independently reconstructs the all-r acoustic classification. AbstractTypeII and contact-line-reserve lemmas extend the fixed-mean operation; the latter handles a concrete quartic negative atI. Whole-left-SO2-cone nonzero-mean coverage is CONDITIONAL onN806 classification. A separate completed-reviewed tangential rigidity theorem excludesJ_r from the coefficientwiseclosed POSITIVE cone of all invertible coordinate transforms of the full bi-SO2 rank-one-convex quartic cone, including singularlimits. This is a method exclusion and all-r nonpolyconvexity proof, not a negative quasiconvexity result. New completed-reviewed results for the SAME original density: r=1 fixed-contact all-amplitude scalar-Hessian Jensen inequality with a reusable heat-bilinear estimate; all-affine r=1 adapted-Hessian support with explicit uniform reserve; and EVERY r>0/EVERY affine mean adapted-Hessian pointwise support, strict all-amplitude Jensen inequality and per-parameter compactness reserve. A separate all-r four-bilinear-square selector factorization gives a globally strictly monotone, nonconservative full constitutive remainder map, and a genuinely convex quartic Psi with explicit Hessian/Bregman reserve. The original full arbitrary-gradient quasiconvexity question remains OPEN. ROOT supplies two standard consequences with full derivations: an all-amplitude relative transverse two-norm neighbourhood uniform over affine means, and a globally defined pointwise inverse of the actual monotone map with explicit one-third Holder modulus. Neither supplies arbitrary-field decomposition or curl-compatible stress inversion.
